name: Amo Cocinar
description: Uruguayan online kitchen store selling appliances, baking and cookware, kitchen tools, coffee and tea equipment and tableware, including KitchenAid and BergHOFF. Ships nationwide with same-day express in Montevideo and pickup points.
description_es: Tienda online uruguaya de cocina: electrodomésticos, repostería, elaboración, bazar, cafeteras y mesa, con marcas como KitchenAid y BergHOFF. Envía a todo el país, con express el mismo día en Montevideo y retiro en puntos.

ships_to.notes: Nationwide; Montevideo and metro area 24 h, interior 72 h via UES; same-day express in Montevideo via PedidosYa

fulfillment.pickup_notes: Pickup at the Malvin store and Mercado Agricola de Montevideo, plus Abitab lockers in Montevideo and Canelones, once the confirmation email says the order is ready.

endpoints.notes: Plain-text llms.txt published by the store for AI assistants.

sources.supports: Shipping options, free shipping threshold, pickup locations
Categories and brands (KitchenAid, BergHOFF), prices shown in $ and USD
